question: Should OpenClaw bundle this Vault SecretRef exec resolver after the policy/type fix, or should Vault remain an external/ClawHub plugin for now?
rationale: The implementation uses the intended SecretRef plugin seam, but a bundled resolver that receives Vault auth material and performs secret-manager network reads changes OpenClaw's trusted security boundary and dependency graph.

options.title: Bundle after repair and approval
options.body: Fix the normalized plugin-policy/type errors, then require current-head secops/dependency approval before treating the bundled Vault plugin as mergeable.

options.title: Keep Vault external first
options.body: Leave the core SecretRef/pluginIntegration seam as-is and ask the Vault implementation to ship as an external plugin or ClawHub package until maintainers want it bundled.

options.title: Pause for security design
options.body: Keep the PR open while maintainers decide the permanent policy for bundled secret-manager resolvers and their approval requirements.

recommendation.title: Bundle after repair and approval
recommendation.body: Fix the normalized plugin-policy/type errors, then require current-head secops/dependency approval before treating the bundled Vault plugin as mergeable.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining non-mechanical choice is the security/dependency trust boundary for a bundled credential resolver.
